integrity: Entire theorem, supporting proof, and standalone Python checker are embedded; mathematical proof supplies universal quantifiers. Published priority cannot be proven exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Binary unweighted stars with one initially dissenting hub; first hub reversal only, not full eventual fixation probabilities or consensus time. The zero mass is an atom, and all infinite-size statements use fixed q>0.
title: A sharp first-reversal threshold for a dissenting hub in nonlinear voter dynamics
